relationships.subject: dimethyl fumarate
relationships.evidence_quote: DMF-DMF, DMF-VEH, and VEH-DMF reduced allodynia and attenuated anhedonia measured at 4 weeks post-SNI, compared to VEH-VEH

relationships.subject: dimethyl fumarate
relationships.evidence_quote: this treatment significantly diminished SNI-induced protein ATF-3 - a neuronal injury marker - in L4-6 DRG at day 49 post-surgery

relationships.subject: trigonelline

key_findings: DMF pretreatment reduced SNI allodynia, anxiety- and cognitive-like deficits, and DRG ATF-3.
